craft_notes: Sthāyin: success — Khecarī's grace (fork LIVE, both readings honored: goddess and practice). Rows: beholding then succeeding. Rejected: deciding the fork — killed: honestly undecided, both carried. Read aloud: certain step.

lines: Ever beholding the grasper — by the Sky-Farer, sure success.
l4.sanskrit_cite: grahītāraṃ sadā paśyan khecaryā sidhyati dhruvam
